title: Meadows – a small language for stock-and-flow diagrams that run
summary: Meadows is a lightweight domain-specific programming language designed for creating and executing stock-and-flow diagrams, commonly used in system dynamics modeling and simulation. It provides a simple, focused syntax for defining system variables, flows between them, and running simulations without complex tooling.
problem_solved: Makes system dynamics modeling and simulation more accessible through a minimal, focused language that can execute diagrams directly.
why_valuable: Enables rapid prototyping and visualization of system behavior with a small, easy-to-learn language tailored specifically for stock-and-flow modeling.
